description: This file defines the interface for device information retrieval, including enums, function prototypes, and documentation for obtaining device hardware details, supported features, and configurations.

methods.name: deviceinfo_architecture
methods.description: Retrieves the device architecture string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_chipset
methods.description: Retrieves the device chipset name string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_serial_number
methods.description: Retrieves the device serial number string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_sku
methods.description: Retrieves the device SKU string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_make
methods.description: Retrieves the device make string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_device_type
methods.description: Retrieves the device type string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_model_name
methods.description: Retrieves the device model name string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_model_year
methods.description: Retrieves the device model year string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_system_integrator_name
methods.description: Retrieves the system integrator name string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_friendly_name
methods.description: Retrieves the device friendly name string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_platform_name
methods.description: Retrieves the platform name string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_firmware_version
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version string, including null terminator, with size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_id
methods.description: Retrieves the binary device ID, including size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_id_str
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID as a null-terminated string, including size management.

methods.name: deviceinfo_audio_outputs
methods.description: Retrieves supported audio output types.

methods.name: deviceinfo_audio_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves supported audio capabilities for a given audio output port.

methods.name: deviceinfo_audio_ms12_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves supported MS12 audio capabilities for a given port.

methods.name: deviceinfo_audio_ms12_audio_profiles
methods.description: Retrieves supported MS12 audio profiles for a given port.

methods.name: deviceinfo_video_outputs
methods.description: Retrieves supported video output types.

methods.name: deviceinfo_output_resolutions
methods.description: Retrieves supported output resolutions for a given video port.

methods.name: deviceinfo_default_output_resolution
methods.description: Retrieves the default output resolution for a given port.

methods.name: deviceinfo_maximum_output_resolution
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum supported output resolution for a given port.

methods.name: deviceinfo_host_edid
methods.description: Retrieves the host EDID data.

methods.name: deviceinfo_hdr
methods.description: Checks if HDR is supported.

methods.name: deviceinfo_atmos
methods.description: Checks if Dolby Atmos is supported.

methods.name: deviceinfo_cec
methods.description: Checks if CEC is supported.

methods.name: deviceinfo_hdcp
methods.description: Retrieves the highest HDCP version supported for a given video port.

methods.name: deviceinfo_dispose
methods.description: Closes cached connections and cleans up resources.
